declared_proof_cutovers.change: The FASTPQ q77 transcript now absorbs the name of the frozen construction (`fips202-atomic-whole-tape-transcript-v1`) and the complete typed profile descriptor (`fastpq.transcript.q77.v1`) in place of the legacy parameter-set name and a hand-written identity string, and the artifact descriptor embeds the same descriptor bytes. Every commitment, challenge and proof byte of the engine changed, and so did both `FastpqCompactProfileIdV1` values.
declared_proof_cutovers.replacement: Direct: no verifier branch, alias or decoder for the previous transcript or profile ids exists. A proof or artifact built before the change is refused: the artifact profile id differs before the child is decoded, and a child proof fails its first challenge.
declared_proof_cutovers.fresh_genesis_reason: The pinned history holds no FASTPQ proof and no State derived from one. A history that stored an ordinary-transfer or AXT artifact under the previous profile needs a fresh genesis with this cutover; no claim is made that such a history replays.

declared_abi_cutover.change: ABI V1 uses the compact CS1 callable schema, declared permission identities, authenticated native event schemas and typed contract-call argument/result tables. The hashed syscall surface describes the current registers, including generation-bound alias operations, and 0xA0 accepts only SubmitBallot. Retired opaque contract calls and the duplicate DEX call surface are removed. The ABI version remains 1; the current complete descriptor determines this hash.
declared_abi_cutover.redeployment: Contracts compiled before this surface change carry an obsolete interface or abi_hash and are refused by decoding or admission. Recompile .ko to .to with the current compiler and deploy its manifest. There is no alias for former hashes or compatibility decoder.
declared_abi_cutover.fresh_genesis_reason: The pinned history holds no contract and no runtime-ABI record: none of its frames contains the ABI hash, which the guard re-checks on every run. A history that holds either needs a fresh genesis with this cutover.
